newsitem.title: FRANCE: CANAL PLUS IN PACT WITH POLYGRAM .
newsitem.headline: CANAL PLUS IN PACT WITH POLYGRAM .

text.p: Canal Plus said it had signed an exclusive long-term agreement with PolyGram Filmed Entertainment to broadcast films on its French paytelevision channels Canalsatellite Kiosque as well as Cine-Cinemas.
Canal Plus did not disclose financial details nor the exact duration of the deal.
PolyGram makes some 20 movies per year.

Canalsatellite is a digital satellite television service which competes with AB Sat and TPS on the French market. TPS is a joint venture of among others TF1 , France Television, Luxembourg's CLT and Lyonnaise des Eaux .
